day: # Christian Worship: A Lutheran Hymnal (NPH, 1993), the Wisconsin Evangelical
# Lutheran Synod: its three-year lectionary (Years A, B and C), used before
# Christian Worship (2021), i.e. for church years beginning 2020 and earlier
# (`when` year lt 2021). First Lesson (ot), Psalm of the Day (psalm, CW 1993
# psalter numbering: 51a, 119b, 139a ... are that psalter's selections), Second
# Lesson (epistle) and Gospel, as the WELS "Planning Christian Worship" (PCWR)
# tables print them (Year A updated 06/2020; B and C 2008-2015), cross-checked
# against the WELS Bible-study guides (CW-Lect*, 06/2015, C Epiphany 03/2019).
# Kinds follow the lesson's place, not its testament (Acts as First Lesson in
# Easter is `ot`; Acts 2 is the Pentecost Second Lesson).
# Where PCWR and the guides differ, PCWR is kept; every difference is listed
# Year A Pentecost 21-23: no PCWR table (the Year A PCWR stops at Pentecost
# 20): guide readings only, no Psalm. Year A Pentecost 24 is in no source; its
# readings here are inferred (titled so): CW 1993's Pentecost 24 in Years B and
# C is the Revised Common Lectionary's Proper 26 (Mark 12:28-34, Luke 19:1-10)
# and Pentecost 21-23 A match Lutheran Worship (1982); Proper 26 A there (LW's
# Third-Last Sunday, second choices) is Malachi 2:1-2, 4-10; 1 Thessalonians
# The Psalms of Pentecost 21-24 A are inferred too, marked "(inferred)": the
# psalm the other lectionaries with these Gospels agree on (LW 1982, LSB, the
# RCL, the ELS): 23, 96, 1 and 43.  CW 1993 shares a psalm with LW on only
# about two Sundays in five, so these are a guess.
# Minor festivals: only the seven the guides happen to cover (no Psalm).
# End Time (the last four Sundays): reformation, last_judgment
# proposed new days.csv ids). Sundays after Pentecost keep CW 1993's numbers
